content:
We introduce Duper, a superposition-based theorem prover broadly similar to Isabelle's Metis. Like Metis, Duper can be used as a standalone tactic to automatically close simple goals, and down the line, we hope to have Duper used as a proof reconstruction method for a Lean sledgehammer. If you're so inclined, please feel free to give Duper a try! You can experiment/play with Duper by importing it in your own project, by cloning this repo which imports both Duper and Mathlib, or via the Lean web editor.

Duper is still in active development so questions, bug reports, and pull requests are all welcome.
